[[Minister]] '''Opodim''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danoor]]. He was one of the four government ministers who ruled the planet and, like his compatriots, was responsible for the well-being of five hundred thousand citizens.
